description: Read-only. Returns one agent's settings: name, address, its Dock email address and whether that mailbox is active, whether iMessage is connected, model, thinking effort (requested and the effective level after the model's cap), execution mode, org visibility, who it is shared with (names and ids), and Do Not Disturb. Changes nothing. Own agents only: an agent may read itself or another agent with the same owner in the same org; a person may read only agents they own. Anything else, including agents merely shared with you, returns 'Agent not found'. Never returns instructions, prompts, memory, keys or phone numbers.

agent_id.description: The agent to read (Dock id, engine id or the agentId address_book returns). Omit to read yourself; required for a person.

name: get_agent_settings
